name: The Millennials Kyoto
detail: This is the only capsule hotel in Kyoto that has a mixed floor, meaning a floor for both guy & girl which is convenient for a couple like us travelling as we don't want to be on different floor for the night. The room is just a bed with all the remote & key being the Ipod that was passed to you during check in. The troublesome thing is to make sure the ipod is fully charged at all time if not, it will affect on how you can control the light, air & stuffs. There is a place for everyone to mingle & eat. Cups & plates are also provided but do remember to do your own washing once you are done.

name: Natural Hot Spring Dormy Inn Premium Kyoto Ekimae
detail: First of all, I definitely would not rate this as a 4-star hotel. However, as a 3-star (like most other hotel websites do), I can defintiely give a 5-star rating. I only stayed here for one night when I took a day trip to Kyoto from Tokyo. The room is small (which is fairly standard in Japan) but I felt that they have put a lot of thought into the layout. Not an inch of space is wasted and everything is within reach. Even the TV gives you a lot of useful information such as whether it's crowded at the natural hotspring on rooftop or whether the restaurant is open. The staff is helpful but the command of English defintely varies. Some of them don't speak English at all but they will happily direct you to someone who does. They were all very helpful with my day trip planning and gave me some very honest advice about my very time-aggressive itinerary (and yes they turned out to be right). For the price I paid I think it's excellent value for the money with all the amenities they provide such as the hot spring and the amazing breakfast spread. Its close proximity to the Kyoto station makes this an excellent jump off point for all the sightseeing needs for Kyoto. I'll definitely stay here again next time I go to Kyoto.

name: Washington R&B Hotel Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi
detail: Highly recommend the newly opened hotel. The location is so nice, within 5 minutes to the riverside and to the shopping center. There are lots of local restaurants and bars nearby. The single room is clean and tidy. No problem fitting two luggage in the room. I've got sound sleep every night.

name: Livemax Hostels Kyoto Ekimae
detail: Great location excellent price and amazing service

name: GLANSIT KYOTO KAWARAMACHI
detail: I booked the superior capsule and it's the best capsule I had so far in Japan. Unlike most capsule, I don't need to check out of my room if I stay for multiple nights here and there's also option to choose for cleaning service for the superior capsule (no extra charges). It's like a mini hotel room with your own desk and door and bed... but without a lock. To me that's good enough because the price is great! Bed wise is very comfortable, not too noisy with a huge TV screen. It's comparable to a sky suite. Locker is huge enough for you to put your luggage in as well as your bags and others items (you have upper and lower storage space in the locker). The capsule although within about 5-10 mins walk from train station, its location is great as situated opposite Takashimaya and the most happening street in Kyoto and next to Gion. I will definitely come back here again to stay if I want save some costs on my accommodation in Kyoto and yet comfortable enough.

name: Onyado Nono Kyoto Shichijo Natural Hot Spring
detail: The room was spacious and the washrooms are excellent.

name: Hotel Hokke Club Kyoto
detail: Pros: Superb location, I came out from Kyoto metro station towards Kyoto tower direction, straightaway saw it on the left hand side of Kyoto tower. Very clean and nicely decorated with quality amenities hotel room. I stayed in the single non smoking room but the room was provided with a queen size bed that can fit two adults (Of course I don’t mean oversized adults). It’s spacious enough to have a small single sofa, small round table and a stool inside the room. Definitely more spacious than most Kyoto hotel room. Nearby there’re numerous nice food stalls or restaurants. Transport wise is definitely a big plus as there are many buses going to tourist attractions. Kyoto metro station is right in front of the hotel. Hotel lobby is at level 2. Level 1 has a nice cafe provided good coffee. Didn’t have chance to eat the breakfast but should be good since the coffee smells good. I will definitely come back again if I come to Kyoto! Cons: no.

name: Natural Hot Spring Super Hotel Kyoto Shijo Kawaramachi
detail: We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights in April 2017 for the cherry blossom season. This was one of the best hotels we stayed at during our 22-day trip in Japan. This was one of the more expensive hotels that we booked. The best thing about this hotel is the location. The hotel was very conveniently located on a quiet, inner street within walking distance to Kawaramachi station, Gion station, the geisha districts, Nishiki Market, restaurants, shops, and Maruyama Park with beautiful views of the river, mountains and buildings while walking to/from Gion. It was easy to remember how to get to the hotel. Also important, it was quiet inside the hotel (no noisy guests). The room we had was probably the largest hotel room we stayed at in Japan (it had space for a long sofa). The bathroom was small like at the other hotels we stayed at. The breakfast had a good variety of choices (very fresh pastries). Complimentary powder green tea was provided in the room, along with kettle and fridge like with other hotels. An onsen is included but we didn't use it. We were able to store our luggage at the hotel before check in and after check out. I wanted to book this hotel for an extra 2 nights when I made a last-minute change to our itinerary a week before we left for Japan (about 3 weeks from the booking dates), but the hotel was full. We ended up booking another hotel about a 10-minute walk from this hotel near Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae station and that hotel was next to a busy street, had noisy guests and did not include breakfast at a slightly higher price. I would choose this hotel again if staying in Kyoto.

name: APA Hotel Kyoto Ekihigashi
detail: Clean place, breakfast is ok, no free parking lots and to park overnight for public place is so expensive. Onsen is free and private. There is washing machine, hotel is clean and new condition. There are 7-11 and Lawson close by. The place is close to Kyoto tower and Isetan and Kyoto station. Totally is ok for spending money here.

name: Sotetsu Fresa Inn Kyoto-Kiyomizu Gojo
detail: Make sure you try the Kyoto Bancha Porridge, a specialty!
